title: Winter Wall Art Set of 3, Midnight Blue Botanical Prints, Frosted Pine Fern Hellebore, Printable Navy Wall Decor, Digital Download
description:
Bring a calm, cool winter mood to your walls. This set of 3 printable botanical prints shows a frosted pine branch with cones and berries, a silvery fern frond with snowflakes, and a pale winter rose (hellebore), all on the same deep midnight blue. They look good hung side by side, as a trio over a shelf, bed or sofa, or one at a time. Download, print at home or at a print shop, and frame.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
- 3 prints: Frosted Pine, Frosted Fern, Winter Rose
- 15 high-resolution JPG files: each print in 5 ratios (2:3, 3:4, 4:5, 11x14 and ISO/A-series)
- 5 PDF files: one per ratio, 3 pages each, set to the largest size of that ratio
- A short guide with the size list and printing tips

SIZES YOU CAN PRINT
- 2:3: 4x6, 8x12, 10x15, 12x18, 16x24, 20x30, 24x36 in
- 3:4: 6x8, 9x12, 12x16, 15x20, 18x24 in
- 4:5: 4x5, 8x10, 12x15, 16x20 in
- 11x14 in
- ISO / A-series: A5, A4, A3, A2 (also fits many 50 x 70 cm frames with a small margin)
Every print has a flat midnight blue background that continues to the edge of each ratio, so nothing important is cropped.

GOOD TO KNOW
- JPG files are about 300 DPI up to roughly 11 x 14 in. Larger sizes (up to 24 x 36 in) are high-resolution enlargements: they look fine from normal viewing distance, but fine detail is softer up close
- Print at 100% (actual size) on matte or satin photo paper, or send the JPG to a print shop; the deep blue looks best on matte paper
- Colors can look slightly different on screen and on paper, and between printers
- Frames, mats and printing are not included. This is a digital download; nothing is shipped

LICENSE
Personal use: print as many copies as you like for your own home and gifts. Please don't share, resell or redistribute the files, or sell prints made from them.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. The files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP from Duskwood Designs Co.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand.
